# Domain phrases for stt_eval.py: `reference text | spelling given to the TTS voice` (the second part is optional).
# These cover the words a small recognizer got wrong in the room ("bring up my 3D printers" came back as a pen).
Mira, bring up my 3D printers | Mira, bring up my three D printers
Mira, how's the print going
Mira, open Onshape | Mira, open On Shape
Mira, open the slicer
Mira, show the vault
Mira, play my music
Mira, show my week
Mira, guest mode on
Mira, set a timer for ten minutes
Mira, what's on my calendar tomorrow
Mira, pause the printer
Mira, what's the SV08 doing | Mira, what's the S V zero eight doing
